Compute the order total as 80 + 80 + 60 + 70 = 290, then apply the 15-star rule that makes one $60 drink free, leaving $230.

questions.skillExplanation: Q26 tests navigation of a conditional decision note about helping a baby bird, including injury status, feather count, nest reachability, and explicit prohibitions.
reasoningOperations: Follow the injured-bird branch, which allows calling the animal center or carefully taking the bird to a hospital but explicitly says not to give it any food.
Compare the other options with the not-hurt branches: leave a feathered bird, call the center if the nest cannot be found/reached, and return a few-feather bird when the nest can be reached.
questions.questionMechanism: Because the prompt asks for the WRONG action, learners must verify all four choices against different branches of a visually structured flow note and detect the one that violates an explicit instruction.
questions.whyTheQuestionWorks: B, C, and D each correspond to a different legitimate branch of the note. A sounds caring but directly conflicts with the parenthetical instruction not to feed an injured bird being taken for help.
questions.correctRationale: For an injured bird being taken to an animal hospital, the notes say to keep it warm and not give it any food. Therefore feeding it first is the wrong action; A is correct.

correctEvidenceRefs.quoteOrDescription: Baby-bird decision notes state under the HURT branch: carefully take it to an animal hospital, keep it warm, and don't give it any food.

B.rationale: This is actually correct advice: if the bird is not hurt and has feathers, the notes say to just leave it there because it is learning to fly.
B.misconceptionTarget: Forgetting that the question asks for the WRONG way and selecting a valid branch as if it were wrong.

evidenceRefs.quoteOrDescription: NOT HURT + HAS FEATHERS leads to 'Just leave it there.'

C.rationale: This is also correct: for a not-hurt bird with few feathers, if the nest cannot be found or reached, the notes direct the reader to call the animal center.
C.misconceptionTarget: Losing the branch condition when reading a flow-style note.

D.rationale: This is correct when the bird is not hurt, has few feathers, and the nest can be reached: the notes say to put the bird back.
